title: How We Built An AI SDR That Books Meetings While You Sleep
description: We built an AI SDR that booked 43 meetings in 30 days while we slept. Cost: $97/month. Here is exact stack, prompt, and what failed.
body:
# How We Built An AI SDR That Books Meetings While You Sleep

We were spending Rs 1.2L per month on an SDR. He booked 12-15 meetings. Good guy. But 70% of his time went in: Finding emails, Writing first drafts, Following up "just bumping this"

We asked: Can AI do the 70% boring part? We built an AI SDR in 4 days. In next 30 days, it booked 43 meetings. Cost: $97/month. No magic. Here is exact build.

## What AI SDR Should NOT Do
Most founders make mistake: They make AI write spammy cold emails. "Hey {FirstName}, I saw you are {Company}..." Everyone knows it is AI. It goes to spam. Our AI SDR does NOT send cold emails. It does 3 jobs only: 1. Finds the right person at right time 2. Writes a personal first line that is not fake 3. Follows up like a human until reply. Human closes the meeting. AI opens the door.

## The Stack - No Code Needed
**1. Lead Source: Apollo + LinkedIn Sales Nav** - Filter: Companies who hired a marketing head in last 30 days, or raised funding in last 90 days, or posted "looking for agency" on LinkedIn. These are buying signals. Not random list.

**2. Brain: Clay.com** - Clay takes Apollo data + scrapes company website + LinkedIn posts + news. Then it gives you 3 bullets: What company does, Recent trigger, One pain.

**3. Writer: ChatGPT via Clay** - Prompt we use: You are an SDR for a fractional marketing firm. Context: {Company Description} Trigger: {Recent Trigger} Task: Write ONE first line under 15 words. Rule: No compliment. No "I loved your post". State a specific observation about their trigger + hint at outcome.

**4. Sender: Instantly.ai** - Sends from 2 secondary domains (not your main domain). Warmup 3 weeks. Max 30 emails/day per inbox. This keeps deliverability >95%.

**5. Follow-up Brain: Our rule** - Day 1: Email with first line + 2 lines value + CTA. Day 3: Bump with a Loom teardown of their ad/landing page. Day 6: Case study one-liner. Day 10: Breakup: "Should I close this?"

**6. Booking: Cal.com + AI voice** - If they reply "interested", our AI auto-sends Cal link + 2 time options in their timezone.

## The Email That Actually Booked
Subject: your Dubai landing page

Saw you hired 2 growth marketers after your Dubai launch - usually means pipeline pressure in new market.

We audited 47 D2C landing pages last month. Most lose 60% traffic because hero talks about brand, not buyer.

Recorded a 2-min teardown of your page - 1 fix that can lift conversion.

Worth 15 mins Thursday?

- Abhishek
Ekalavya Consulting | We fix leaky funnels without hiring full team

P.S. If not relevant, say no - I will close.

## What Failed - So You Don't Waste Time
**Failed 1: Fully AI email.** Reply rate 1.2%. Human-edited first line + AI rest = 8.7% reply rate. Human touch in first line is non-negotiable.

**Failed 2: Sending 100 emails/day.** We burned a domain. Gmail blocked. Now 30/day/inbox = safe.

**Failed 3: AI booking without human check.** AI booked a meeting with a student who wanted internship. Now we have filter: Company <10 employees or < $1M revenue = AI auto-tags "Not ICP" and doesn't send Cal link.

**Failed 4: No video.** Plain text emails got 3% reply. Same email + 60-sec Loom teardown link got 11%.

## Numbers After 30 Days
Emails sent: 620 (30/day)
Open rate: 67%
Reply rate: 8.7%
Meetings booked: 43
Show-up rate: 71%
Closed: 6 clients
Cost: $147 total vs 1.2L salary

**If you sell B2B service above 50k/month and have one case study, you can build this in 48 hours.**

faq.question: What is an AI SDR?
faq.answer: An AI SDR is an AI sales development representative that automates research, lead qualification, personalization and follow-ups to book meetings. It handles 70% of repetitive SDR work while humans close meetings.

faq.question: How much does it cost to build an AI SDR?
faq.answer: You can build an AI SDR for $100-$150 per month using tools like Apollo, Clay and Instantly. This is much cheaper than a full-time SDR salary of Rs 1 lakh plus per month.

faq.question: Can AI SDR replace human SDR completely?
faq.answer: No. AI SDR is best for finding triggers, writing first lines and follow-ups. Human is still needed for discovery, handling objections and closing. Best model is AI for 70% work, human for 30% closing.
